maddeler.e:
تحاشيت (form VI)
# تَحَاشَيْتُ (taḥāšaytu) /ta.ħaː.ʃaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# تَحَاشَيْتَ (taḥāšayta) /ta.ħaː.ʃaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# تَحَاشَيْتِ (taḥāšayti) /ta.ħaː.ʃaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
